headline: LNG shortage: Load shedding increases as gas supply drops
summary: Power outages surged to over 2,500 MW by Wednesday evening after a floating LNG terminal shut down due to lack of cargo.
details: Load shedding has intensified across Bangladesh, including in Dhaka and rural areas, following a sharp decline in gas supply. The crisis was triggered when Accelerate Energy's floating LNG terminal (FSRU) shut down at 3 PM on Wednesday due to a lack of LNG cargo.

According to Petrobangla, LNG supply to the national transmission line dropped from 66.1 million cubic feet (mcf) at noon to 56.2 million mcf by 6 PM on Wednesday. Total gas supply, including domestic sources, fell to 218.9 million mcf, leaving a deficit of approximately 161.1 million mcf against a daily demand of 380 million mcf.
The impact on power generation was immediate. Power grid data shows that load shedding was only 117 MW at 10 AM on Wednesday, but surged to 1,067 MW by 2 PM and 1,804 MW by 5 PM.
By 7 PM, as electricity demand peaked at 17,345 MW, the supply dropped to 14,815 MW, resulting in a massive 2,530 MW of load shedding. Another 2,443 MW of load shedding was recorded at 9 PM.

Industry experts state that the combination of rising demand and falling gas supplies has made it nearly impossible to utilize full production capacity. Residents are facing severe hardship due to the outages amidst intense heat, and the situation may persist through Thursday if there is no rain.

headline: Tigers soar: Bangladesh players jump in ICC Test rankings after Australia win
summary: Najmul Hossain Shanto and Hasan Mahmud reach career-best positions following the victory in Darwin.
details: Following a significant victory over Australia in Darwin, several Bangladesh players have seen a substantial rise in the ICC Test rankings.
Najmul Hossain Shanto and Hasan Mahmud have climbed to their career-best positions in the rankings as a result of the win.
The victory has provided a major boost to the team's standing and individual player rankings on the global stage.
Meanwhile, Australian player Travis Head has lost his top position in the rankings following the defeat.
caption:
Career-best rankings for Shanto and Hasan! 🇧🇩

Following a significant victory over Australia in Darwin, several Bangladesh players have seen a substantial rise in the ICC Test rankings.

Najmul Hossain Shanto and Hasan Mahmud have climbed to their career-best positions in the rankings as a result of the win.

The victory has provided a major boost to the team's standing and individual player rankings on the global stage.

Meanwhile, Australian player Travis Head has lost his top position in the rankings following the defeat.
